english.title: Drivers hours - permit driver to exceed 90 hours driving in fortnight - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to drive a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for a total period in excess of ninety hours during the fortnight ending at 24.00 hours on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) in contravention of Article 6(3) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A)of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exceptions for the period from 1st November 2021 ending with 22nd January 2022: see regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 4) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1207) which permits drivers engaged in domestic goods transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 6 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 4(1) where a driver may exceed the total accumulated driving time during any two consecutive weeks of 90 hours by up to 9 hours.
Temporary exceptions for the period from 4th October 2021 ending with 31st October 2021: regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 3) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1106) permits drivers engaged in domestic goods transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 6 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 4(1) where a driver may exceed the total accumulated driving time during any two consecutive weeks of 90 hours by up to 9 hours.
For the period from 9th August 2021 and ending with 3rd October 2021: see regulation 4(1) of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 2) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/921), where a driver may exceed the total accumulated driving time during any two consecutive weeks of 90 hours by up to 9 hours. A driver may only rely on the exception where one of the requirements in regulation 2 applies.
(ii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iii) See section 103 for other definitions.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3183 and H3185.
